turns.user: I want to stop cutting and start building muscle instead

args.reason: Wants to shift focus from losing fat to building muscle size.

turns.user: does that change what I'm eating as well, or just the training?
turns.reply:
It changes both. 

To build muscle, we need to shift you out of a calorie deficit and into a mild calorie surplus so your body has the extra energy it needs to actually synthesize new muscle tissue. 

If you confirm the change, your daily target will bump up from your current 1,660 calories to around 2,100 calories. Your protein will stay high to support recovery, but you'll get a lot more carbs and fats to fuel your training and growth. The app will automatically scale up the portion sizes of your scheduled meals to match these new targets.

On the training side, the plan will rebuild to focus on hypertrophy—shifting your rep ranges, volume, and structure to maximize muscle growth. 

Does that make sense, or do you want to look at how the new macro split breaks down first?
